title: Affine comparison for affine transition limit
statement: For an affine transition limit cone whose stages are affine, the limit point is canonically isomorphic to the spectrum of the colimit of global sections, compatibly with projections.

proof.text: Install affineness of every stage. Mathlib Scheme.isAffine_of_isLimit gives affineness of c.pt. Applying isColimitOfPreserves Scheme.Γ to hc.op gives a colimit cocone of global sections, using Mathlib preservesColimit_Γ for affine stages.

Let eΓ be the unique isomorphism from Γ(c.pt) to the chosen ring colimit. Compose c.pt.isoSpec with Scheme.Spec.mapIso eΓ.symm.op. The coprojection equation comp_coconePointUniqueUpToIso_inv and Spec.map_comp reduce projection compatibility to Scheme.isoSpec_hom_naturality.

blueprint_update.statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed set and $(D_i)_{i\in I}$ an inverse system of schemes indexed by $I$ whose transition morphisms $D_j\to D_i$ ($i\le j$) are affine, and suppose every $D_i$ is affine. Let $c$ be a limit cone of the system, with vertex $D$ and projections $\pi_i:D\to D_i$. Then there is an isomorphism $e:D\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Spec}\bigl(\varinjlim_i\Gamma(D_i,\mathcal O_{D_i})\bigr)$ such that for every $i$ the composite of $e$ with $\operatorname{Spec}$ of the colimit coprojection $\Gamma(D_i,\mathcal O_{D_i})\to\varinjlim_j\Gamma(D_j,\mathcal O_{D_j})$ equals $\pi_i$ followed by the canonical morphism $D_i\to\operatorname{Spec}\Gamma(D_i,\mathcal O_{D_i})$.

proof.text: The vertex $D$ of a limit of affine schemes along affine transition maps is affine. The global-sections functor sends the limit cone to a colimit cocone of rings $\Gamma(D_i)\to\Gamma(D)$, so there is a unique ring isomorphism $\Gamma(D)\cong\varinjlim_i\Gamma(D_i)$ compatible with the coprojections. Compose the canonical isomorphism $D\cong\operatorname{Spec}\Gamma(D)$ (as $D$ is affine) with $\operatorname{Spec}$ of this ring isomorphism. The compatibility with the projections follows from the compatibility of the ring isomorphism with the coprojections and the naturality of $X\mapsto(X\to\operatorname{Spec}\Gamma(X))$.
